content: The slowdown was caused by the cluster’s default DNS configuration. Because the pods used the default `ndots:5` setting, short hostnames were first expanded with the cluster’s search suffixes before being queried directly. This extra resolution step caused the lookups to stall and produce `EAI_AGAIN` errors. In short, the DNS `ndots` setting (and lack of an override in the notification‑worker deployment) was the root‑cause.
name: gather
